reviews.text: Training went smooth. Step by step, professional and communication was great. My furbaby (Stormi) is well trained, follows direction and I am able to take her everywhere with me..service dog training went smoother than expected!

This service animal training was a wonderful experience. The support and guidance of the trainer was also something that made these sessions so successful.
Highly recommend!
Great training! Our rescue learned so much and we hope to continue training her! We chose the service dog training and were very satisfied. Highly  recommend!
Our GSD Rango did the service dog program, including off-leash work inside and outside the house. We were very happy with K9 Specialist and definitely recommend them!

Phenomenal training. I worked with William Perez and he was an expert on all things K9 training. Not only did he know how to instill obedience into my dogs he was equally as effective at explaining it all to me so that I could learn as well. Best dog training I have ever had. Highly recommend this company.
Daviel A. Provided professional, patient and exceptional training. I am so pleased with the expert training provided. Thank You for your support.

I highly recommend K-9 Specialist!  We had our Hope trained as a medical alert service dog.  The trainer was incredible and
very knowledgeable!  THANK YOU!

As an expecting mother, my husband and I were eager to improve our dog Sunny’s behavior and temperament before welcoming our baby, and we could not be happier that we chose K9 Specialist.

Daviel was exceptional from the very beginning. He is extremely skilled, knowledgeable, professional, and truly a pleasure to work with. We have seen an enormous improvement in Sunny’s behavior, and the difference has been noticeable not only to us, but also to our friends and family, who continue to comment on how much her behavior has improved.

We are incredibly grateful for Daviel’s guidance and the progress Sunny has made. We feel so much more confident and prepared as we get ready to welcome our baby into our home. We would highly recommend K9 Specialist and Daviel to anyone looking for an experienced, effective, and trustworthy dog trainer!

I can’t say enough good things about my experience with K-9 Specialists. From beginning to end they are very responsive and patient answering questions and providing resources. We rescued a shepherd mix puppy that has some special needs and wanted to make sure that she had proper training. Our trainer Debora is phenomenal! Our dog absolutely loved her and she was so patient in accommodating her needs and going above and beyond to help us navigate any challenges.

I love that K-9 provides ongoing support in community sessions for the life of your pet. It’s evident that this is a business of people who are extremely good at what that do but also they love dogs and want to see them thrive!
Dayana, I recommend them, they're very good.
Excellent service. The instructor was very knowledgeable and allowed us to start our puppy  journey with confidence.

14 weeks with Debora, and it's bittersweet to write this. She was patient from the start but firm, teaching me to navigate waters I'd never swam in before. Thanks to her, Sinbad now walks beside me — heel, sits to say please, stays. I can count on him. I feel she saw a light in both of us, which as a first time dog parent means a lot. I know she's a phonecall away, but we'll miss our Wednesday ritual. Can't recommend her enough.

The best decision we ever did for our furr baby was sign him on for training with K9 specialist! The level of dedication from our trainer was seen every session. The feeling of being in great hands and also having immense support with our first & new puppy!
Great experience with K9 specialist they really know what there doing with a great team of trainers that care!

Our dog Lani just completed all sessions for Basic advanced training. Her behavior/demeanor has improved tremendously over the course of 12 weeks. Daviel our trainer did a great job and is extremely knowledgeable! I can’t recommend him and K-9 specialist enough!!

Molly’s training experience with Dayana, K-9 Specialist, has been wonderful from beginning to end. We started with basic puppy skills and advanced training because we wanted to help Molly improve her manners, obedience, and overall behavior.

Dayana was patient, caring, knowledgeable, and truly took the time to understand Molly and what she needed. We could see the difference not only in Molly’s training, but also in her confidence and our ability to communicate with her.

We are so grateful for the time, dedication, and love Dayana put into working with Molly. She gave us valuable tools that we can continue using at home, and we feel much more confident in helping Molly become the best dog she can be.

Thank you, Dayana, K-9 Specialist, for everything you’ve done for our sweet Molly. We highly recommend her to anyone looking for a trainer who genuinely cares about both the dog and their family! ❤️🐾

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Daviel did an amazing job training my Lulu! Very professional, patient, and you can tell he genuinely understands dogs and cares about what he does. I noticed a real difference. Highly recommend Daviel to anyone looking for a great dog trainer!

Dayana trained Pisko and was an excellent professional. She was very patient, caring, and dedicated throughout the process. Pisko learned so much from her, and we are very happy with the results. Thank you, Dayana, for all your hard work, love, and dedication with our little boy. We truly appreciate you! ❤️🐶

I can’t say enough wonderful things about our experience with K-9 Training! Milo has been training with them since he was just a puppy, and watching his progress throughout this journey has been such a rewarding experience.

Dennis was extremely helpful from day one. I first called him when Milo was only two months old, and he was very informative, understanding, and took the time to answer all of my questions. He recommended the best classes for Milo based on his age and needs.

Dayana has been Milo’s trainer since he was a puppy, and she has been absolutely incredible. She is extremely professional, knowledgeable, patient, and caring. Her communication is excellent, and she consistently follows up to keep me updated on Milo’s progress and training. She has also been wonderful about recommending the best products based on Milo’s needs.

Milo has now completed his basic and advanced training, and we recently completed his service dog certification as well.

I would highly recommend K-9 Training to any dog parent looking for professional, knowledgeable, and caring trainers. Thank you for being such an important part of Milo’s journey 🐾

Dayana did an outstanding job training my French Bulldog, Milton. From the very beginning, she was knowledgeable, patient, and genuinely invested in his success. She took the time to explain not just what to do, but why it worked, which made it easy for me to continue reinforcing the training at home.

Milton has made tremendous progress, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. Dayana was always professional, encouraging, and clearly has a real passion for working with dogs. I highly recommend her to anyone looking for a trainer who is effective, reliable, and truly cares about both the dog and the owner.

Worked with William to bet my dog Service Certified. The program was fantastic and the training sessions were clear and concise. Rider, my dog, completed his training and is now certified! I can’t express how grateful I am to the program and the trainers. Really are the best!

I’m so glad we chose K9 Specialists to help train our little Goldendoodle, Mila. From the very beginning, our trainer, William Perez, treated her as if she were his own. His patience, kindness, dedication, and incredible knowledge made all the difference. He truly went above and beyond every step of the way.

Watching Mila grow into the confident, well-mannered, and reliable service dog she is today has been an amazing journey. William never gave up on her and always took the time to ensure both Mila and we understood each lesson. His encouragement and genuine passion for what he does gave us confidence every step of the way.

Today, Mila proudly works alongside us as our service dog in our dental practice, and we honestly couldn’t be happier. She has exceeded our expectations, and we know none of this would have been possible without William and the entire K9 Specialists team.

Investing in Mila’s training has been one of the best decisions we’ve ever made. If you’re looking for a trainer who truly cares about your dog and is committed to helping them succeed, we wholeheartedly recommend K9 Specialists—and especially William Perez. We would choose them again without hesitation.

Thank you for changing not only Mila’s life, but ours as well. We are forever grateful. ❤️

If you are still debating with yourself if you should get your dog trained, do it and do it with K-9 Specialist. It will change your life! Our dog trainer, Daviel, is the nicest person and has a wealth of knowledge about dogs. He is training our husky, Zulu, that we thought was untrainable, to become a service dog. It is a non-treat-based training where you learn to communicate with your dog in a clear and precise way. It is like learning a new language and it creates a strong bond of love and trust between owner and dog. It is like magic once you fully commit to the process. Zulu loves Daviel and is looking forward to our weekly training sessions. It feels empowering to be able to control your dog. And you will have people commenting on how well your dogs behave. Thank you, Daviel. You make training so much fun and you make us love Zulu more and more.

Very happy with the progress. dayana was the best. Shw really knows her stuff but most importantly, she taught us how to think. Doga is super educated now. Thanks!
Tomas

I can’t recommend Daviel enough! He has been training my corgi, Buddy, for the past 3 months, and the transformation has been incredible. Buddy has gained so much confidence, learned excellent obedience, and is now well on his way as a service dog thanks to Daviel’s guidance.

Daviel is patient, knowledgeable, and truly cares about both the dog and the owner. He takes the time to explain the training process, answers every question, and makes sure you’re learning how to continue the training at home. His methods are clear, effective, and tailored to each dog’s personality.

Working with Daviel has been one of the best decisions I’ve made for Buddy. If you’re looking for a trainer who is professional, dedicated, and genuinely passionate about what he does, I highly recommend him. Thank you, Daviel, for everything you’ve done for Buddy and for giving us the tools to succeed together!

K9 specialists have now trained 3 of my family’s dogs over the years. I recently finished the advanced off leash program with my dog. He was 8 months old when we started his lessons and had some basic obedience down. We were having a hard time with his training due to impulse control and excessive barking. It started leaning into confidence issues and I was afraid of him developing other behavioral issues such as fear aggression.

Our trainer assigned was William and we could not be happier with the results. William helped us create structure and build confidence in our dog. He is now able to go out with us anywhere we go with confidence. He is well socialized and now goes to dog parks, beach days, dog hunting group sessions, and more. We can basically take him anywhere we want on or off leash with full confidence. I would recommend k9 specialists to anyone looking to find a team of trainers that help you have a well socialized and socially adjusted pup.

The other plus is the group classes for life! Those group classes really helped us achieve our goal with a controlled environment and guidance from the trainers.

Thank you William and K9 specialists for helping us get Snoopy to the best version of him!

I want to share an update to my previous review after our international flight since I feel it deserves even more recognition.
We can’t recommend William enough! He did an incredible job training our dog Zeus. The biggest test came when we traveled from Miami to Milan, Italy, a 9-hour international flight that we were honestly nervous about.
Thanks to William’s training, Zeus was absolutely amazing throughout the entire trip. He stayed calm, listened to every command, never bothered anyone, and handled the long flight better than we could have imagined. Traveling internationally with a dog can be stressful, but William prepared Zeus so well that the experience was smooth from start to finish.
We are incredibly grateful for everything he did for Zeus and would recommend him to anyone looking for outstanding dog training. Thank you again William!

It has been a phenomenal experience. It has been excellent training through William. My dog ​​has responded excellently because Willian is an excellent trainer. I am very grateful for my dog's progress.
With each passing day, I feel prouder of having trained my dog ​​with William; outside of the actual training sessions, he taught me so much about how to be the best handler for my Belgian Malinois. Thank you for everything.

William and the K9 team are really great.  I have a big strong Doberman and after 1 session I was able to walk him without him pulling. It was a game changer for me. I got great tips on how to handle Zazu plus a strong base of obedience training.   Thanks!

I had a great experience with K9 specialists. My Yorkie, Copper, was only 4 months when he started training with Daviel. Daviel was extremely knowledgeable on all things dog related. He has great experience as a trainer, and trained my puppy so quickly. Copper learned commands within a couple of months and is now a service dog. I 100% recommend k9 specialist and Daviel for all dogs big and small.

I had the pleasure of speaking with Dennis on the phone for almost 35 minutes.  He gave me amazing tips on how to handle my Doberman malinois mix and ways to keep him active. I can’t wait for my ben to be trained by his amazing team.

Dayana! What a professional this woman is! Her knowledge was evident in every situation and every question. All our concerns were resolved with her genuine experience. Tomasa is a timid and nervous dog, and Dayana understood. She proceeded accordingly to ensure her training was flawless. Each class featured a different command, gradually building a solid foundation to continue until Tomasa graduated from the Service Dog Basic Advanced Training Program.

I have a six month old American Bulldog puppy who weighs 98 lbs and I needed help!  I was really overwhelmed with him— he is a lot to handle.  Our trainer William came to the rescue—he was great.  Now I have the tools and training to manage him and we can even enjoy pleasant walks around our neighborhood.  William has turned Rip into a different dog, and we are very happy with K9 Specialist’s services.

David is the best dog trainer! From the very first session, it was clear he understands dogs on a different level—not just commands, but behavior, timing, and what each dog needs individually. We have an Old English Sheepdog, and right away David went to work to help him, myself, and us-creating a strong a team!

He’s VERY patient and confident, our dog absolutely loves him and responded to him immediately! David didn’t rely on quick fixes—he focused on consistency and teaching both me and my dog how to communicate better. We have the best relationship today, thanks to David!

What stood out most was how much he cares. He doesn’t treat training like a routine job…he actually adjusts his approach depending on the dog’s personality and progress. After just a few sessions, I noticed real changes at home and on walks! David is also willing to help whenever needed, even when we aren’t with him he’ll always respond to our messages in times of need. There were a few cases I needed help or advice, and he always got back to us with support and care. I honestly trust his opinion more than anyone’s!

If you’re looking for someone who’s knowledgeable, reliable, and genuinely invested in your dog’s success…David is absolutely the one to go with!!!

We signed up our 5 year-old mini Aussie, Lenny, for the Service Dog training, and it was the best decision we ever made for him. David is an exceptional trainer—passionate, patient, professional, and extremely knowledgeable. Every single suggestion and homework he’s given us has significantly changed Lenny’s behavior for the better. He doesn’t just give you instructions, he takes time to explain the why behind it, and then shows you how to integrate the training into your daily life. We can’t recommend David enough, he’s the real deal!!!
David our dog trainer is one of a kind. He really understands what needs to be done and has the best solutions to all of our dog problems

Fantastic experience! David Pereda is a patient and knowledgeable trainer, he truly cared about my dog. It was worth every penny, in just a few sessions, I saw a huge improvement. I highly recommend David, it is the only trainer I will allow to work with my dog.

I cannot recommend David Pereda from K9 Specialist enough! When we first started training, my dog, a Belgian Malinois was a handful. She had previous training but without my knowledge it was  based on fear and a lot of electric collar. She is a new dog now, finally recovered her confidence, and her personally has blossom to be a fun, loving family dog, and of course obedience but without fear.
5 Stars to David Pereda.

We have a wonderful Belgian Malinois but which took us 3 trainers to find the appropriate one to keep up with her energy level, sense of work & mischievousness.
David Pereda with K-9 Specialist have the patience & knowledge to bring the best out of our dog & finally she has learn boundaries & social conduct. Our dog was traumatized by the previous trainers who sadly used force & punishment to teach. This is not the case with K-9 Specialist.
We had a great experience with K9 Specialists. Daviel was the best trainer - so professional and knowledgeable. I highly recommend him!
My puppy was a monster , I had 12 session training with Daviel and my puppy is such an angel. I’m planning to take her now to the next level. Definitely recommend
Thank you, Mr. Freddy, for training Denver. Denver is a completely different dog. 100% recommended

Freddy is the best trainer in the world, 100% recommend🙌🏻🙌🏻
Freddy is an amazing trainer. Our dog is changing his old behaviors and becoming more obedient in each class. I am really happy with his work and I highly recommend him and K-9 Specialists.

Every session feels calm, focused, and tailored to your dog’s needs, and the progress shows quickly. Highly recommend her to anyone looking for real, lasting results with their dog.

Yesterday was the last class for Logan  we have a beatiful experience  with the trainer Dayana Brow  she is very good  with the dog lot of love  and patience  we highlight  recoment her   thank to you ❤️

I Dr. Christopher Blanco, recommend K9 specialists without reservations.

Diana is an excellent dog trainer! Very patient, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do. We saw real improvement in our dog’s behavior quickly. Highly recommend.

If I could give them 10 stars, I would. My puppy's trainer was Dr. WILLIAMS. One of the most experienced dog trainers in South Florida. Very patient and loving. My puppy became a service dog with outstanding behavior thanks to him! We miss you, Dr. Williams. Keep up the great work! ♡

This had to be one of the BEST dog training experiences ever! We had actually hired two other training companies before, and unfortunately neither one worked for Oakley. I was honestly starting to lose hope, but hiring K-9 Specialist (trainer:  Daviel) was the best decision we could have made.

Daviel was incredibly knowledgeable, patient, professional, and truly understood Oakley and his behavior. From the very beginning, you could tell he genuinely cared and knew exactly what he was doing. Every session was informative and effective, and the results have been absolutely amazing.

Oakley has made SUCH a huge improvement. His behavior, focus, and confidence have completely changed. I truly didn’t think training would finally work after our past experiences, but boy was I wrong!

Every single penny was worth it, and I would recommend K-9 Specialist (trainer: Daviel) to anyone looking for real results with their dog. Thank you for helping Oakley and giving us the tools to succeed. We are beyond great-full!!!

Debra has been amazing! I met her when my puppy was 2 months and he would not sleep at night and chew everything. She transformed my puppy in an amazing, smart, well mannered boy! Dennis is great, he has put together an amazing team of people. He helped me with traveling documents and he is super accommodating
Dayana was an amazing trainer for my dog Canelo :) we had a lot of fun training together and she gave me very useful tips for his behavior. 10/10

From our initial consultation with Jael, I knew I made the right choice with K-9 Specialist. The entire experience was smooth, supportive, and encouraging every step of the way.

My goal was to train my rescue pup, Priscilla, as a service dog. We started when she was just 4 months old - so as you can imagine, she was quite a handful! But Darien and William handled her with incredible patience and skill. They are both extremely knowledgeable and dedicated, and will support you through all aspects of training.

At just 7 months old, Priscilla has accomplished so much, and that is a true testament to the K-9 Specialist team. We are so grateful for the amazing experience and couldn’t recommend them more!

I started looking for a good dog trainer for my dog Toby because he was very reactive towards other dogs and aggressive with his food. After finding K-9 Specialist they assigned Lenin to work with my dog. One thing I can say is that Lenin had lots of patience and is a good person to talk to. Not only is he an amazing dog trainer but he also gave me a lot of tips and tricks for my dog that later became very helpful. If you’re looking for amazing dog trainers then I would definitely recommend K-9 Specialist.

Lenin was such a great help with my dog (Morita). I wanted to get her trained because she was reactive and timid towards people and I wanted to get that fixed before it became a bigger issue. Lenin had so much patience not only with my dog but also with me in training her. He showed me how to correct certain issues she was showing and with time and constant practice I now have the confidence to walk her out in public without worrying that she might become reactive to other people. I am so thankful for Lenin and K-9 Specialist for helping me with my Morita. 10/10 would recommend to anyone looking for a good dog trainer for their dog.

We did the basic advanced training with Deborah for my 1 year old Aussiedoodle. She was very excitable around other dogs and people and was excessively barking and pulling on her leash. The training helped her gain confidence and she’s made huge improvements. We did a lot of trainings in places with other dogs so she could practice not barking and walking calmly past other dogs which was a tremendous help for her. She can now walk past other dogs and calmly go about her way, which is a big deal for us! My dog absolutely loved Deborah and looked forward to her training sessions. We can’t thank her enough!
Freddy has been amazing with my lab! He’s patient, knowledgeable, and truly cares about the dogs he works with. I’ve seen a huge improvement in my dog’s behavior and confidence. Highly recommend!
Excellent service! Trainer Freddy was amazing. My two Goldendoodles graduated from the basic obedience course and their behavior improved significantly. Now they follow basic commands.

K-9 specialist Denis has done an amazing job with my German shepherd literally 15 years ago, I was able to take him with me everywhere with no problem at all, around people and other animals, it was the best we had out of all our pets.
My shepherd passed at the age of 16.
I definitely recommend their services.

We are beyond grateful for Daviel  From the very beginning, Daviel was calm, confident, and incredibly knowledgeable. He took the time to really understand our dog’s and our family dynamic, and he created a plan that actually worked.

The transformation has been amazing. Our dog is more balanced, responsive, and we are excited for our service dog in training. What I appreciated most is that Daviel didn’t just train our dog — he trained us. He gave us the tools, structure, and confidence to be great pet owners.

If you have dog and feel like you want him to be well trained call Daviel. It has truly been a game changer for our family.
David was outstanding!  Grateful for his assistance and look forward to working with him with my next pup.

David is a truly exceptional dog trainer. He came highly recommended to me by a friend of a friend, and I’m so glad I had the opportunity to work with him. He helped me change the way I relate to my dog, which made a huge difference. My 1-year-old Cockapoo, Lulu, now has much more structure and consistency, no longer pulls on the leash, and has made real progress with crate training and recall. David quickly understood why the methods I had been using were not working, explained the reasoning behind his methods, and gave me specific homework each week that really helped. It took commitment, but it was absolutely worth it. I can’t recommend him enough.
Thank you sir for your five-star review.

I found the K9 Specialist Team through a quick Instagram search. After speaking with the owner, Dennis, he explained how their training process works and the different tiers they offer.

I have a 1-year-old male mini dachshund named Oakley. After a biting incident, I realized I needed to hire a professional dog trainer to make sure it didn’t happen again.

I was lucky enough to be paired with Darien, and I truly can’t say enough good things about him. From the very beginning, he was extremely professional, knowledgeable, and patient. He took the time to understand Oakley’s behavior and explained every step of the training process so I could continue reinforcing it at home.

Darien worked with Oakley on key commands like sit, stay, and place, and most importantly helped address the biting behavior. What impressed me most was his confidence and the way Oakley naturally responded to him. You can tell Darien genuinely cares about the dogs he works with and takes pride in the results he delivers.

The progress Oakley has made has been incredible, and I’m extremely grateful for Darien’s dedication and expertise. If you’re considering training for your dog, I highly recommend the K9 Specialist Team.

We highly recommend k-9 specialist our dog Ziggy has learned so much thanks to the patience of the amazing trainer he had. If you are thinking about it I would definitely say give them a call you won’t regret it

I had an amazing experience with William at K9 Specialist. He trained my dog Zeus through the service dog program and the results have been incredible. William is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and truly cares about the dogs he works with. Zeus has improved so much in obedience, focus, and confidence. I’m very grateful for his work and highly recommend him to anyone looking for professional dog training.

— Mary & Zeus 🐾

Dayanna is the best trainer! She helped me manage Milo so we could travel together and go out every day, something we had tried before without success. She was incredibly patient and had the best attitude! I 100% recommend her!

Dennis was incredibly professional and made the entire process smooth and stress-free. Their training support was excellent and made a huge difference for my dog Mia.

Thanks to them, Mia can now travel with me to Argentina without any issues. Highly recommend their services!

I can’t say enough great things about K9 Specialist Dog Training and our trainer, David. He has been working with my German Shepherd, Ace, since he was just a puppy, and now at 1 year old, the results are incredible.

David is extremely knowledgeable, patient, and truly understands the breed. German Shepherds are smart and high-energy, and David knew exactly how to channel that energy into focus, obedience, and confidence. Ace is now well-behaved, responsive, and a joy to be around both at home and in public.

What I appreciated most is how David not only trained Ace but also taught me how to properly communicate and work with my dog. The guidance, consistency, and professionalism made all the difference.

If you’re looking for someone who genuinely cares and delivers real results, I highly recommend K9 Specialist Dog Training and David. Five stars all the way!

We cannot recommend our dog trainer David enough! From the very beginning, he truly listened to all of our concerns and goals and took the time to understand exactly what we wanted for our dog. He guided us every step of the way and taught us how to properly care for and handle him with confidence.

Thanks to his dedication, patience, and expertise, our dog has become the perfect service dog. Every time we bring him out in public, we receive an abundance of compliments on how well-behaved he is and how well he listens to our commands. It’s honestly a reflection of the incredible training and David gave us.
Excellent team, and trainer Dayana is the best. Thanks to everyone, I now have a well-trained dog.

The best decision we've ever made was training our little dog 🐾. Trainer William did an excellent job. We're so happy with her classes and so proud of our daughter's improved behavior. 100% recommended

Just finished the basic advanced class for my 7 year old, reactive cocker spaniel Loki. William was an amazing trainer! He taught me how to help my dog be less aggressive. I recommend K-9 Specialty to anyone wanting a better behaved dog...ask for Wiiliam as a trainer 😀.
We are very happy with the results we have seen with our dalmatian Goku. Davielle is his trainer and Goku loves him! Thank you for helping us with Goku!

William was our trainer for Max’s 14-week service dog program, and we are beyond grateful for his guidance.

He is extremely knowledgeable and does a great job explaining how dogs think, learn, and what they truly need to succeed. I learned so much throughout this process and grew into a confident handler because of his coaching.

Max now has excellent manners, and I can take him anywhere with confidence. The moment his vest goes on, he knows he’s in work mode. That foundation is a direct result of William’s expertise and dedication. We highly recommend him!

I can not speak highly enough of K-9 Miami. Our trainer, Daviel, has changed our lives.
My 7 year old rescue, Jax, was unpredictable, timid, and fearful. I’d reached a point of hopelessness, unable to relax or take him anywhere.
Over the course of a year, Daviel has been helping Jax and I build trust and develop the skills and confidence to be comfortable even in unfamiliar environments.
